source_evidence: Player exact 'Thank you captain. Lets see if we can deliver Crownsunder's diplomatic invitation and visit the map room regarding Nightglass today'. Current verified source pins: prep/dm-only/dm-orsaven-framework.md @9d35d62e1d25f9021a8105d1d8bd8db9bc583758, prep/dm-only/dm-estate-ancestry.md @582dd9cfe965575548562916b606e5965813b522, world/politics/human-states.md @77333e27aa5946858c824352e71af893aa6e1b96, quests.md @788da3648505be80d1556cbe5b2eeb0e7cce3a1d. Both routine visits possible in late working hours today, no arbitrary access roll; actual duty clerk, actual collection keeper/custody and physical comparison, no claim of recovered historic receipt prior to this scene. Distinguish sealed handover from monarch's reading/answer, ordinary scholarly source copy from provenance and commission payout. Current field-book finding is specified by prepared source, not an added missed clue in old Hall search. D325~18:45 Orsaven map room, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar present, ordinary city visit completed after D325~17:25 Desen financial review. V explicitly thanks Desen and chooses both Crown invitation delivery and Nightglass map-room inquiry today. At~17:50 ordinary royal correspondence receiving office still has a duty clerk; V presents limited authenticated messenger credentials and physically delivers original SEALED Crownsunder preliminary invitation, clerk accepts into authorized royal dispatch custody and issues ordinary dated acknowledgment of receipt. V retains messenger credentials and receipt; no personal monarch audience, ministerial reading, policy answer, agreement, fee or disclosed Kestrel evidence; delivery task completed, official response pending. Ossent's established cooperation condition remains suspension of Crownsunder's throne claim; Crownsunder has not conceded; no V power to negotiate binding terms. At~18:15 map-room keeper finishing work receives the party, checks collection correspondence, confirms actual receipt of Edric's signed D290 field-book request (prior transit not claimed as previously verified), permits supervised inspection and copying of nonrestricted post-Convergence survey. Mara's Hall carrier-mark/packing notes compare with identical mark on depicted hauling frame beside collapsed western Ossent crossing; two banks, surviving pier and broken aqueduct alignment locate last documented recovery/packing district of the silver-veined heart. Keeper authenticates field-book copy/sketch from actual collection custody, Mara retains it with comparative annotations; original field book stays collection, Hall originals and heart remain at Nightglass/Severin. Not proof of maker, bloodline, father's death, heart speaker or exact ancient site functions. Actual itinerary 48 road miles +12 rough miles, ~3 days each way under ordinary conditions, not guaranteed. No expedition yet undertaken, no further ancient-site secrets revealed. Documentary milestone evidence now available for Coris's assessment; 300gp contingent not received or booked, optional800gp field milestone not earned. Edric's other correspondence and Severin assent remain unconfirmed. The Ferrymen's Share financial-trail inquiry open: Desen identified pre-death account4-C payment to local shipwright for two ferry hulls; yard directions given, voluntary visit tomorrow possible, no warrant, recovery or evidence custody change. Quenwood life sentence upheld; assets frozen; no restitution yet distributed. Both D325 magic orders accepted, deposits140+120 paid, target353 local collection; balances280+240=520 not paid; no reserved purse or finished magic items. Serpent Dart supplier not secured. Purse2051gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR5/6; no second inn booking or D325 overnight yet. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old ordinary shield retained HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attack+9, greataxe unaffected. Mara and coach/four horses healthy, animals at Copper Hart. Separate Crown intelligence commission introduction retained,300+1300 contingent, Kestrel originals V and other evidence custody unchanged, Elara Caereth. V dice delegated. Await next choice at evening map room; no assumed inn payment, rest, reply, expedition or further action.
